entities.name: Carina Witthöft
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carina Witthöft is a German former professional tennis player. She won one singles title on the WTA Tour whereas on the ITF Women's Circuit, she won eleven singles titles and one doubles title. On 8 January 2018, she reached her career-high singles ranking of world No. 48.
